summary: Full backend and frontend testing of AI Writing Assistant. All 7 backend API tests passed. Frontend loads correctly with dark theme and all 4 mode tabs. Grammar generation, empty validation, mode switching all work. Copy to clipboard fails only in headless browser automation due to browser clipboard permission restriction (not a code bug).

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText fails in headless browser (Write permission denied). This is expected browser security behavior in automated environments. On a real browser it should work fine. Consider adding a fallback using document.execCommand('copy') for broader compatibility.

issues: Dark theme looks clean and professional. No contrast or spacing issues observed.

action_items: Optional: Add clipboard fallback (execCommand) for environments where navigator.clipboard is not permitted
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean and well-structured. No issues found.
App.js correctly clears output and context on mode switch.
Error handling in handleGenerate correctly extracts detail from API error responses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs working. Frontend working. Only known issue is clipboard permission in headless browsers - not a real code bug. Grammar, Email, Tone, Rewrite modes all tested and working with Claude Sonnet 4.5.
